description: Presidential Secretarial - Order Call out w.e.f. 22.11.2019, all the members of Armed Forces for the maintanance of Public Order, under the Public Security Ordinance
reasoning: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Public Security Ordinance to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. This constitutes a legal/regulatory action as it invokes statutory powers under an existing ordinance (Chapter 40) and creates a legally binding order with specified schedules of districts and forces. It does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio assignments that would fall under Types 1-3, nor does it fit the specialized categories of land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
